newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes slightly higher.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly higher on Wednesday against its U.S. counterpart following the greenback's mild weakness overseas, but profit-taking limited the gain, dealers said.
The local unit rose to T$27.711 in early trade but tailed off late to finish at T$27.734, only slightly higher than Tuesday's T$27.736 close.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$239.5 million.
"The Taiwan dollar is still trapped in a downtrend, so there was immediate profit-taking after it rose a little," said one dealer at a foreign bank.

The local dollar closed at a 10-month low on Tuesday on foreign fund outflows triggered by concerns over Taiwan's deteriorating social order following the murder of a famous actress's daughter and subsequent street protests against the government's handling of rising crime.
Dealers said the outflows were likely to continue in the near term.
A T$27.71-75 range was seen for Thursday.
